text:
Jordan Lee: Hey all — monitor arrived but stand hardware looks like it’s missing the screws and the height bracket. Also my laptop can’t join the corporate Wi‑Fi (redwood-sec). Getting an authentication error. Any quick pointers?
Aaron Patel: welcome Jordan! @Jordan Lee ping IT in this thread, they’ll sort hardware. :tada:
Marisol_IT: Hi Jordan — sorry about that. Can you DM the shipping label number and post the monitor serial here? Also what error do you see when joining redwood-sec?
Jordan Lee: Shipping label: 1Z999AA10123456784. Monitor serial: RWD-MN-3A12X7. Wi‑Fi shows "802.1X auth failed" after I enter my SSO creds.
Marisol_IT: Thanks. I’m creating a ticket now. In the meantime try connecting to redwood-guest and then open the onboarding VPN link: https://intranet.redwood.dev/onboard-vpn — if that fails, post a screenshot.
it-bot: Ticket created: INC-2026-0345 (assigned to it_support).
Tony Crawford: Hey Jordan — I’m Tony from IT. I’ll check the packing manifest and either route the missing stand hardware or send a replacement monitor if needed. I’ll include a USB keyboard + spare keycap kit in the replacement box. ETA for shipment: 2 business days.
Jordan Lee: Thanks Tony. Quick Q: keyboard that came with the laptop is also missing the "Fn" keycap and the Bluetooth pairing doesn’t show up. It was a plugged-in USB keyboard but nothing lights up.
Tony Crawford: Noted — I’ll swap that keyboard. For the Wi‑Fi 802.1X error, try forgetting the redwood-sec network and re-join with this config in Settings -> Network -> Add: SSID: redwood-sec, EAP method: PEAP, Identity: your sso email, Phase 2 auth: MSCHAPV2. If still failing, reply with the exact error or screenshot.
Jordan Lee: Will try the rejoin steps in 5. Appreciate the quick responses.
Marisol_IT: Leaving a note on the ticket to prioritize new hire gear and Wi‑Fi provisioning. @Tony Crawford I added Jordan to the hardware pickup list.
Jordan Lee: Re-joined successfully! Wi‑Fi is working now. :relieved: Also laptop keyboard still dead so I’ll keep the ticket open for the replacement keyboard.
Tony Crawford: Great — closing the auth part, keeping hardware open. Delivery tracking will be emailed to you under the ticket. :truck:
Jordan Lee: Perfect, thanks everyone!
